SELECTED_CONSTRUCTION_ROUTE.description: For each prime p>=17, take three copies A,B,C of F_p and retain 15 translation parallel classes indexed by the first 15 powers of the least primitive root modulo p. Convert each block to one signed 3-CNF clause with a deterministic 7/8 sign split by slope index.

routes_considered.PROJECTIVE_STS31_PLUS_SIMPLE_CYCLIC_VOLT: FEASIBLE_BUT_NOT_SELECTED; a simple fixed-base layered cover has an obvious constant-size-fibre/layer decomposition route and weak prospective width-obstruction value.
routes_considered.RANDOM_REGULAR_LINEAR_3_UNIFORM_HYPERGRA: NOT_SELECTED; probabilistic existence/random generation is forbidden as the final construction.
routes_considered.FULL_PROJECTIVE_STEINER_TRIPLE_SYSTEM_FA: NOT_SELECTED; in STS(v) the point replication number is (v-1)/2, so exact degree 15 fixes v=31 rather than giving an unbounded family.
routes_considered.FINITE_FIELD_TRANSVERSAL_DESIGN_15_PARAL: SELECTED; deterministic, connected-targeted, 3-partite, linear-targeted, exact degree 15, unbounded and hash-free.

EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.INDEX_SET: K={p : p is prime and p>=17}
EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.PRIMITIVE_ROOT_RULE: g_p is the least integer g in {2,...,p-1} having multiplicative order p-1 modulo p
EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.SLOPE_RULE: s_j(p)=g_p^j mod p for j=0,...,14; retain the j-order and do not sort by residue value
EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.VARIABLE_SET_k: V(F_p)=A_p union B_p union C_p with A_p={A_x:x in F_p}, B_p={B_x:x in F_p}, C_p={C_x:x in F_p}
EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.CLAUSE_SET_k: For every x in F_p and j in {0,...,14}, E_{x,j}={A_x,B_{x+s_j},C_{x+2s_j}}, arithmetic modulo p.
EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.INCIDENCE_RULE_k: A_a in E_{x,j} iff a=x; B_b in E_{x,j} iff b=x+s_j mod p; C_c in E_{x,j} iff c=x+2s_j mod p.
EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.SIGN_RULE_k: All three occurrences in E_{x,j} are positive for j=0,...,6 and negative for j=7,...,14. Each variable must therefore receive exactly 7 positive and 8 negative occurrences once exact 15-regularity is proved.

CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION_RULE.rule: Use the frozen USF-R0 canonical_formula and canonical_dimacs_bytes semantics after the fixed DIMACS-ID/sign map: duplicate literals collapse, duplicate clauses collapse, literal order is (abs(lit), negative-after-positive), clauses sort lexicographically, ASCII LF, exactly one final LF, header nvars=max used variable id.
CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION_RULE.scientific_identity: SHA256 of exact frozen canonical DIMACS bytes

EXACT_FAMILY_DEFINITION.GENERATION_COMPLEXITY_TARGET: Deterministic polynomial in output size Theta(p): validate prime index, deterministically factor p-1, find least primitive root by increasing search, compute 15 slopes, emit 15p clauses, canonicalize and serialize. No bit-complexity-optimal claim is made.

PROOF_OBLIGATION_MANIFEST.statement: |V(F_p)|=3p and tends to infinity along K.
Each E_{x,j} contains exactly one A-, one B-, and one C-variable and hence three distinct variables.
Every A_a,B_b,C_c belongs to exactly one block for each j=0,...,14 and hence exactly 15 clauses.

Any two distinct E_{x,j},E_{y,k} share at most one variable; sharing any two parts must force x=y and s_j=s_k, and slope distinctness forces j=k. The A/C case uses invertibility of 2 modulo odd prime p.

The incidence graph is connected. Prospective proof route: for j!=k, A_x connects through B to A_{x+s_j-s_k}; any nonzero difference generates additive F_p because p is prime; every B/C vertex attaches to the resulting A-component.
Exactly one occurrence per j plus the fixed sign rule gives each variable exactly 7 positive and 8 negative occurrences.
Distinct clause indices never produce the same unsigned triple; prove directly from A-coordinate and slope injectivity or as a consequence of E3+E5.
The exact canonical DIMACS bytes can be generated deterministically in time polynomial in output size.

E3-E8 instantiate the already-certified linear-15-regular-7/8 conditional corollary: linearity+bipolarity->NO_BCE; linearity+7/8->56 distinct non-tautological BVE resolvents; 56>15->NO_BVE; linearity->R34 exclusion; linearity->single-literal RUP irreducibility; 15-regular+7/8->NOT_HORN; therefore HASH_FREE_ONE_CYCLE_FROZEN_REDUCER_FIXPOINT_LEMMA applies.

future_failure_policy: Any falsifier means CONSTRUCTION_CANDIDATE_FAIL and STOP. Any changed target/incidence/sign rule requires a new preregistration; no post-result repair of this target.
literature_orientation: Yuki Irie, Combinatorial Game Distributions of Steiner Systems, Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 28(4) (2021) #P4.54, DOI 10.37236/9252: standard projective Steiner triple systems.

Jonathan L. Gross and Thomas W. Tucker, Generating all graph coverings by permutation voltage assignments, Discrete Mathematics 18(3) (1977), 273-283, DOI 10.1016/0012-365X(77)90131-5: classical graph-cover/voltage framework.
Standard design-theory equivalence: Latin squares <-> TD(3,n), and TD(3,n) gives a 3-partite linear 3-uniform incidence structure.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Under separate authorization only: prove or falsify E1-E10 for this exact preregistered route.
